name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 24, 2015
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ADJOURNMENT
ROLL CALL
Recommended Action:
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION - Nancy B. Jones, President of the Woman's Club of Vista*3
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring Thursday, February 26, 2015, to be "Katrina Patterson Day" in the City of Vista, in honor of being chosen as the "Vista Boys & Girls Club Youth of the Year."
P2.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, February 25, 2015, to be "JC Wynne Day" in the City of Vista, in honor of being chosen as the "City of Vista's 2014 Person of the Year."
P3.
Presentation by Bryan Gruber, Partner, Lance, Soll & Lunghard, on the Fiscal Year 2013/14 Audit.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending December 31, 2014 (CC)
C4.
Unscheduled Vacancies on Various Boards and Commissions (CC)
1.
Robert Fukutomi, Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Advisory Board, as the Vista Village Business Association's representative, for a term ending June 30, 2015;
2.
John Kilby, Senior Citizens Affairs Commission, for a term ending June 30, 2015;
3.
Mary Lou Clift, Douglas Arlt, and Jacob Bell, Mobile Home Park Review Board, for terms ending June 30, 2018; and
4.
Sarah Spinks, Public Arts Commission, for a term ending June 30, 2015.
C5.
San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) Smart Growth Incentive Program
Grant (CC)
C6.
Merger of CIP No. 8225 and CIP No. 8254, and Approval of CIP No. 8225 Street Construction and Overlay Project Change Order No. 2 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving the merger of CIP No. 8225 Street Reconstruction and Overlay Project and CIP No. 8254 Sidewalk at South Melrose and Ridge Road Project, and approval of CIP 8225 Change Order No. 2 for the construction contract with ATP General Engineering; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Capital Improvement Program budget for the FY 2014/15.
C7.
CIP No. 8276 Skate Park Project - Design/Build Agreement Award (CC)
C8.
CIP No. 8264 Agua Hedionda Pedestrian Bridge Project - Design/Build Agreement
Award (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with Orion Construction Corporation; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Capital Improvement Program budget for the FY 2014/15.
C9.
Public Arts Commission "Kites Over Vista" Project Selection (CC)
C10.
First Amendment to the Second Amended and Restated Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement for North County Dispatch Joint Powers Authority (NCDJPA) (CC)
C11.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) (CC)
C12.
Sale of City Property (CC)
C13.
Ergonomic Office Furniture for City Facilities (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with G/M Business Interiors; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2014/2015.
C14.
Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (ROPS 15-16A) (SA)
1.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2015- , approving ROPS 15-16A; and
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2015- , approving the Administrative Budget.
DISCUSSION
D1.
Bike Lanes and Removal of Parking on Civic Center Drive (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
Recommended Action:
No Public Hearing items are scheduled.*3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
